sources.snippet: For multi-user serving (8+ concurrent requests), pipeline parallelism via --pipeline-parallel-size 2 often outperforms tensor parallel on PCIe—it avoids the all-reduce overhead entirely, with each GPU acting as an independent pipeline stage. The full concurrency breakdown is in vLLM vs Ollama in 2026: When Each One Wins.
